scope: Standalone lossless GPU transfer codec: all 28 layers use our Dense or Rank256 predictor/rANS. The rolling encoder computes each nonzero-layer prediction product once, retaining only two temporary INT32 matrices. Decoder, original complete packets, fitted coefficients, fixed binary-CDF inverse and BF16 words stay fixed. A paired cached-Dense control retains the preceding verified setup optimization. SplitZip and ExANS are separate unchanged controls, not candidate components. Compact-search graph execution at 512 tokens and direct-search execution at 8192 tokens are retained. These two documents are reused engineering evidence, not independent generalization. Link costs are calculated, not NIC/SSD, resident P or serving measurements.
